raid-colossus.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production legendary (ancient grade, raid exclusive) equipment item icons for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG. Image1 is the existing ANCIENT equipment sheet of this game: match its finely detailed pixel-illustrated painterly style, dark outlines, lighting and scale, and the exact diagonal orientation of its swords (hilt at bottom-left, tip at top-right). Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FIVE separate items in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-5, and the sixth cell (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Each item centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge: (1) a massive greatsword forged from riveted dark steel plates with glowing molten-orange seams, (2) a heavy fortress-like great helm with a narrow glowing visor, (3) a thick riveted steel breastplate with molten core in the chest, (4) a necklace pendant of a small glowing anvil-shaped molten core on an iron chain, (5) a round iron seal medallion with a hammer and gear emblem and molten-orange runes. All five share one design language: IRON COLOSSUS raid relics: blackened steel, rivets, molten orange glow. They are the rarest raid trophies: more ornate than any other gear, each clearly distinct. Each item clearly readable at small icon size. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
